Son of the Mayflower passenger George Soule and Mary Buckett of Duxbury.
His father was one of the original purchasers of Dartmouth, and by 1686 George and his brother Nathaniel were living
there. His death is recorded at Dartmouth on 12 May, but the year is torn away.
Deborah, wife of George Soule the younger of Dartmouth, Massachusetts; her surname is unknown.
